name: Oblivisci Memorias
source:
Everyone in town used to speak greatly about the apothecary. Customers of all backgrounds were welcome and never discriminated against. Whatever ailed them, the cauldron could brew a potion for everything. But ever since the incident that torments you even in your sleep, things have changed.

You didn’t always run this shop by yourself.

[from [url=https://rainslices.itch.io/oblivisci-memorias]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
镇上的每个人过去都对药剂师赞不绝口。各种背景的客户都受到欢迎，并且从未受到歧视。无论他们有什么不适，大锅都可以调制出治愈一切的药剂。但自从那件连睡梦中都折磨你的事件发生后，事情就发生了变化。

这家店并不总是你一个人经营的。

[来自[url=https://rainslices.itch.io/oblivisci-memorias]itch.io[/url]]
